description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans reminders table using MySQL as the backend database. It tests initialization, range retrieval, parallel upsert, and simple reminders functionality within the Orleans reminder system.

classes.name: MySqlRemindersTableTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing Orleans reminders table with MySQL backend, derived from ReminderTableTestsBase.

methods.description: Creates logger filter options for the test class, setting trace level for logging.

methods.description: Returns the ADO.NET invariant name for MySQL.
